title: expect() in production code in send_request (ws/mod.rs)
description: ws/mod.rs line 98: val.as_object_mut().expect("JmapRequest serializes to a JSON object") is in production code inside WsSession::send_request. The comment notes this cannot fail for JmapRequest, which is true today, but if JmapRequest's serde impl ever changes (e.g. to serialize as an array for some reason), this panics instead of returning an error. Idiomatic approach: .ok_or_else(|| ClientError::Serialize(...))? to propagate as an error. The client.rs line 423 expect (valid_up_to boundary) is more defensible as a mathematical invariant from the standard library, but should still have a comment explaining the proof.
